tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Can you turn on the light?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Can you pick me up from the station?”

B hears the question and answers with the tiles. A pronoun (it, them, you) goes in the middle of a phrasal verb: turn it on, not turn on it. If the answer is in the past, change the verb: took, turned.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
